# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HDF5 static library build for RadarSimCpp
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# This project does not contain any source code of its own. It downloads a
# pinned release of HDF5 with FetchContent, builds the static C/C++ libraries,
# and stages the resulting headers and libraries into ./output in the layout
# expected by RadarSimCpp:
#
#   output/include/               - Common HDF5 C/C++ headers
#   output/include_<platform>/    - Headers generated by the build (H5pubconf.h)
#   output/lib_<platform>/        - Static libraries (.a / .lib)
#
# The HDF5 version is pinned by HDF5_GIT_TAG. To build a different release:
#
#   cmake -S . -B build -DHDF5_GIT_TAG=2.2.0
#
# Normal usage is through ./build.sh (Linux/MacOS) or build.bat (Windows).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# HDF5 2.x requires CMake 3.26 or newer.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)

project(hdf5_lib_build LANGUAGES C CXX)

include(FetchContent)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HDF5 source location and version pin
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(HDF5_GIT_REPOSITORY "https://github.com/HDFGroup/hdf5.git"
    CACHE STRING "Git repository to fetch the HDF5 source from")
set(HDF5_GIT_TAG "2.1.1"
    CACHE STRING "HDF5 release tag to build")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output directories
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HDF5 only sets these itself when it is the top-level project (see
# SET_HDF_OUTPUT_DIRS in config/HDFMacros.cmake). Built as a sub-project it
# leaves them alone, so set them here to collect every library in build/bin.
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/bin")

set(HDF5LIB_OUTPUT_DIR "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/output"
    CACHE PATH "Directory the staged headers and libraries are written to")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HDF5 build options
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HDF5 declares some of these with option() and some with set(... CACHE ...),
# so force the cache entries to make sure both kinds are overridden.
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_STATIC_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HDF5_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HDF5_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HDF5_BUILD_UTILS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HDF5_BUILD_CPP_LIB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HDF5_BUILD_HL_LIB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HDF5_BUILD_FORTRAN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HDF5_BUILD_JAVA OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HDF5_ENABLE_SZIP_SUPPORT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HDF5_ENABLE_ZLIB_SUPPORT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fetch and build HDF5
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
message(STATUS "HDF5 source: ${HDF5_GIT_REPOSITORY} @ ${HDF5_GIT_TAG}")

FetchContent_Declare(
    hdf5
    GIT_REPOSITORY "${HDF5_GIT_REPOSITORY}"
    GIT_TAG "${HDF5_GIT_TAG}"
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
    GIT_PROGRESS TRUE
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(hdf5)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Platform name used for the output directory suffixes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(WIN32)
    set(HDF5LIB_PLATFORM "win_x86_64")
elseif(APPLE)
    if(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES)
        list(GET CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES 0 HDF5LIB_ARCH)
    else()
        set(HDF5LIB_ARCH "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
    endif()
    if(HDF5LIB_ARCH STREQUAL "arm64")
        set(HDF5LIB_PLATFORM "macos_arm64")
    else()
        set(HDF5LIB_PLATFORM "macos_x86_64")
    endif()
else()
    set(HDF5LIB_PLATFORM "linux_${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
endif()

message(STATUS "HDF5 staging platform: ${HDF5LIB_PLATFORM}")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage headers and libraries into ${HDF5LIB_OUTPUT_DIR}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The copying is done by a script run at build time so that the file globs pick
# up everything the build generated, and so that the header list never has to
# fit on a command line.
add_custom_target(stage ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
        "-DHDF5_SOURCE_DIR=${hdf5_SOURCE_DIR}"
        "-DHDF5_BUILD_DIR=${hdf5_BINARY_DIR}"
        "-DHDF5_LIB_DIR=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:hdf5-static>"
        "-DOUTPUT_DIR=${HDF5LIB_OUTPUT_DIR}"
        "-DPLATFORM=${HDF5LIB_PLATFORM}"
        -P "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/stage_hdf5.cmake"
    COMMENT "Staging HDF5 headers and libraries into ${HDF5LIB_OUTPUT_DIR}"
    VERBATIM
)

add_dependencies(stage
    hdf5-static
    hdf5_cpp-static
    hdf5_hl-static
    hdf5_hl_cpp-static
)
